'''Östersunds Fotbollsklubb''', commonly known simply as '''Östersunds FK''', '''Östersund''' ({{IPA|sv|œstɛˈʂɵnːd}}) or (especially locally) '''ÖFK''', is a Swedish professional [[Association football|football]] club located in [[Östersund]], [[Sweden]], that plays in the Swedish second tier, [[Superettan]]. The club was formed in 1996 as a merger of several Östersund clubs. The club is affiliated with the [[Jämtland-Härjedalens Fotbollförbund]]<ref>{{cite web |url= https://svenskfotboll.se/svensk-fotboll/om-svff/distrikten/?ffid=10 |title= Kontaktuppgifter och tävlingar – Jämtland-Härjedalens Fotbollförbund – Svenskfotboll.se |access-date= 2011-01-12 |archive-date= 14 December 2011 |archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20111214125307/http://svenskfotboll.se/svensk-fotboll/om-svff/distrikten/?ffid=10 |url-status= live }}</ref> and play their home games at [[Jämtkraft Arena]]. The club colours, reflected in their crest and kit, are red and black, predominantly in stripes and with red shorts and socks. 

From its creation, the club played mostly in the [[Division 1 (Swedish football)|third tier]] of [[Swedish football league system|Swedish football]] but in 2013 Östersund achieved promotion to the second tier, [[Superettan]], after achieving two consecutive promotions. In 2016, Östersund was promoted to the Swedish first tier, [[Allsvenskan]], for the first time.<ref>{{cite web |url= https://svenskfotboll.se/cuper-och-serier/information/?feid=7385 |title= Kontaktuppgifter och tävlingar 2013 – Östersunds FK |access-date= 20 January 2013 |archive-date= 24 February 2018 |archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20180224112844/https://svenskfotboll.se/cuper-och-serier/information/?feid=7385 |url-status= live }}</ref> In 2017, Östersund won the [[Svenska Cupen]] and qualified for the [[UEFA Europa League]]. The club was relegated to Superettan in 2021.<ref>{{Cite web |title=TV: Från vinst mot Arsenal till allsvensk nedflyttning - här är ÖFK:s uppgång och fall |url=https://www.fotbollskanalen.se/allsvenskan/tv-fran-vinst-mot-arsenal-till-allsvensk-nedflyttning-har-ar-ofks-uppgang-oc/ |access-date=2022-05-13 |website=fotbollskanalen |language=sv |archive-date=3 November 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211103031116/https://www.fotbollskanalen.se/allsvenskan/tv-fran-vinst-mot-arsenal-till-allsvensk-nedflyttning-har-ar-ofks-uppgang-oc/ |url-status=live }}</ref>"}}
